title: Shattered Arcana — Phase 7 Sprint Report (2026-04-07)
content:
Phase 7 Sprint completed 2026-04-07.

SUBSYSTEMS BUILT:
- CoMDiplomacySubsystem: Relations, treaties, reputation (-1000 to +1000), war declarations with casus belli, mutual defense cascades, AI personality-driven diplomacy, war weariness, vassal system, gift system with diminishing returns.
- CoMEspionageSubsystem: Spy agents with skill/XP/leveling, 8 mission types, counterintelligence, captured agent handling, double agents.
- CoMMagicSubsystem: Mana economy with nodes, spell casting, spell research, rituals, rune inscription, global enchantments, dispelling, counter-magic.
- CoMSubsystemBridge: Cross-subsystem event wiring.
- CoMDragonSubsystem: Split from HeroSubsystem (SOLID).

BUG FIXES (13): 2 crash, 2 compile, 9 logic bugs.
TEST SUITE: 65 tests across 10 files.
Total: 115+ source files, 28,000+ lines.

title: Shattered Arcana — Codebase Audit & Fix Pass (2026-04-08)
content:
Full 193-file C++ codebase audit with 5 parallel agents, followed by systematic fixes.

~125 FIXES ACROSS ~45 FILES:

CRITICAL BUGS FIXED:
- Diplomacy: AreAtWar treated None treaty as war (all wizards at war by default). Peace proposals set treaty to None (peace couldn't work). AI diplomacy returned MAX in every branch (no-op). All fixed.
- Magic: Ritual ManaInvested >= ManaInvested (self-compare, always true — rituals completed instantly). Mana cost overwritten to 0. Fixed with ManaCostTotal field.
- Espionage: All switch case labels commented out — every mission executed all reward types. Durations all 1 turn. Fixed.
- Resource: ProcessTradeTurn modified AllOutbreaks during iteration (crash/UB). Fixed with temp array.
- Combat: All FFixed64 constants ~10x too small (FromRaw(500) for 5%, should be 3277). Weather switch jumbled. Fixed.
- World: Every tile defaulted to InfernyxCorruption (no None value). Volcano unreachable. Fog broke at map edges. Fixed.
- Turn: Most subsystem ProcessTurn calls disconnected from TurnManager. Now all 12 wired.

ARCHITECTURE FIXES:
- 4 subsystems changed UWorldSubsystem → UGameInstanceSubsystem
- FogOfWarSubsystem rewritten to delegate to WorldMapSubsystem (was dual system)
- ECoMRace enum deleted, 7 files migrated to FGameplayTag
- Layer constants unified: FULL_LAYERS_PER_PLANE=3, TOTAL_MAP_LAYERS=24
- FFixed64 overflow protection via __int128/_mul128
- CoMCommandQueue Within= UHT fix
- 3 network stub .cpp files created

DESIGN DECISIONS:
- Deleted ECoMRace (orphaned, gameplay tags used instead)
- Underwater is full grid layer (3 per plane, 24 total)
- FFixed64 uses __int128/__mul128 for overflow safety
- 21 weather types assigned combat modifiers
- Hero counting is per-wizard (not global)
- ResourceToTradeGood lookup table (50 mappings)
- Quest generation filtered by active wizard count

ASSET GAPS FILLED:
- 258 missing terrain tile PNGs generated (all 196 ECoMTerrain values now covered)
- 68 UI assets generated (panels, buttons, bars, frames, icons, HUD, cursors)
- Asset pipeline fixed (77% size reduction, 1.6GB → 366MB)

Project now at: 193 C++ files, ~30K lines, 1333 gameplay art assets, 21 test files, 16 subsystems all wired.
